$comment: A record, not a control file. Nothing in @piotr-miller/ai-toolkit reads this file; it exists so a human — or an agent onboarding into this repository — can see which package, profile, tools and exact version own the authoring skills here, without a private dependency in package.json and without tracked installation state. The CLI's own state lives in .ai-toolkit/manifest.json, which is gitignored. See AGENTS.md.
